simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מוּצַק (H4164) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מוּצַק (mûwtsaq) means narrowness ; figuratively, distress First listed occurrence: Isa 8 23.

definitions.full: H4164. mutsaq II. מוּצָק מוּצָק, noun [masculine] constraint, distress ; — absolute מוּצָק Isaiah 8:23 distress ; absolute also מוּצָק Job 36:16 , of distress as constraint (opposed to רַחַב ); בְּמוּצָ֑ק מַיִם רֹחַב 37:10 , literally in constraint (i.e. frozen). — 1. מוּצָק see יצק .
